[LSTO.4.5.1] **In-session must-not-lose — an engine guarantee.** The
cache is engine state ([LSTO.4.7.1]), as durable as working memory
within a session: a written key stays readable (subject to TTL,
[LSTO.4.6]) until `cache_delete` or a superseding write. A `cache`
write does not silently drop.
